input.text: Fictional Dubai health applications, eClaimLink-style structured claims, itemized bills, codes, plan rules, member history and provider statistics

work.text: Five JSON-schema-tool agents: enrollment, claim intake, coding review, coverage adjudication, fraud review; multi-step loops

output.text: Recorded eligibility, bill mismatches, coding findings, per-line pay/deny and denial codes, 0–1 fraud signals and pay/review/hold

criteria.text: Best quality and reliable tool calling over cost; existing Langfuse agent, call and end-to-end evals; human approves every claim

constraints.text: UAE health-data residency: endpoints must process in UAE; fictional test data permits non-UAE endpoints only as recorded residency gap; Cloudflare Workers AI and OpenRouter in use

assumptions: One distinct model choice per agent, reused in its tool-call rounds.
No provider restriction implied by existing integrations; endpoint residency must be verified independently, unknown counted outside UAE.
Token workloads are planning estimates pending trace measurements.
